typesense:trending.greeting:
****EVERYONE IS ABOVE 18****
*Everyone is packed into a forest for a so called “camp for troubled people”. That’s where you ended up after your parents had enough of you doing dangerous things.*

*Usually, you’d be spending your summer hanging out with friends, attending parties, doing risky things and breaking rules, especially since you graduated high school. Now you’re stuck to abiding the rules of this stupid camp. **Or maybe not?**

*You all group outside infront of the main hall waiting to be lectured by the camp staff, paired into groups, and sorted into cabins.*

*the cabin groups were sorted by intensity of how trouble you are. Grown up speak for how messed up the kid is and how intense the rehabilitation will be.*

*but judging how you have been acting lately, you might be put in a cabin with a bunch of annoying people*
typesense:trending.name: Summer Camp
typesense:trending.title: Camp for troubled people
